historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly recognizes the manual boundary but volatile device names and tail-only logs cannot prove all-drive coverage or delayed errors.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds stable serial/WWN mapping, per-drive operator records, RAID/mount/boot protection and complete OS/BMC evidence.
historical_reviews.related_cases: This row checks mechanical insert/remove and clean system response for HDDs; LED-specific and RAID-fault cases are independent.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Every action must identify the exact drive/slot and expected final population; an unspecified repeated-cycle interpretation is not permitted.

original_test_intent: Verify that each approved HDD can be safely inserted into and removed from its mapped backplane slot and that only the intended device state changes without unexpected storage errors.
original_method: A qualified operator performs each approved insertion/removal while the agent captures stable identity, controller/RAID/mount/health and complete OS/BMC evidence before and after every action.
manual_activity: User approves the full drive/slot/order/data plan; qualified operator inserts/removes each HDD; agent records complete identity-bound system evidence.
required_inputs: HDD serial/WWN/model to physical slot/backplane/controller map
Action order, cycle count and intended final population
Hot-swap or powered-off insertion/removal and ESD procedure
Qualified operator, OOB/console, abort limits and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Verify each drive/slot and hot-swap capability before handling
Exclude boot/management/production/unknown media unless individually approved
Quiesce I/O and protect RAID/filesystem state
Preserve complete logs and stop on resistance, wrong identity, rebuild/degrade, filesystem/media/thermal/power/BMC error or access loss
Do not manipulate bays, rebuild, repair, reboot or repeat automatically
agent_execution_scope: Capture complete stable drive-slot/controller and storage-health baseline
Record each operator action timestamp and pre/post enumeration
Collect RAID/mount/health/temperature and complete Windows/Linux/BMC logs
Verify approved final population; do not handle hardware or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve matrix, order, service/data and recovery plan
Provide qualified operator and own any array/filesystem recovery
Review every per-drive record and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: lsblk assists Linux enumeration but insecure SSH and a short dmesg tail cannot prove physical mechanics, all-drive mapping, RAID/data safety or full per-action error state.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secure complete stable-ID/controller/RAID/mount/health and full-log capture before and after every qualified-operator insertion/removal.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All-HDD insertion/removal, normal mechanics and source 15/8 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run an identity-locked physical action matrix with complete per-step controller and OS correlation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact population, data protection and traceable evidence without replacing mechanical judgment.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Automation assists observation; it cannot perform or attest the physical action alone.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Drive names can reorder and arrays may start background work asynchronously, so stable IDs and controller state govern.

project_override_considerations: For simple-swap hardware, all insertion/removal must occur powered off; the source action remains manual and must follow the platform service guide.
expected_evidence: Operator identity, timestamps and physical observations/photos
Final population/restoration, recovery notes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master and references agree on physical HDD insert/remove; GPT V2 fills missing scope and safety controls.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Operator, mapping and service/data procedure are supplyable prerequisites; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Makes all-HDD physical coverage auditable by exact stable identity and complete per-action storage state instead of a generic device list.
independent_technical_reasoning: Mechanical success and logical storage response are independent: a drive can seat normally yet map to the wrong controller slot or trigger array errors, while device names can reorder after hot-plug. Stable serial/slot correlation, controller state and full logs are therefore required alongside operator observation for each action.
